title: Typed text in characters the form font cannot encode depends on the PDF viewer
symptom: in a fillable PDF, text typed in Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Hebrew, Devanagari, Thai, Cyrillic, Greek or Latin letters such as Ł or č may not display, or be saved without an appearance; the export names each field already holding such text
workaround: fill those values in the Word document before exporting, or use a viewer that substitutes fonts
